status: Analysis specification prepared during production; no adaptive stopping or favorable-cell selection
population: 48 conditions,1000 fixed datasets each,full/deletion methods; historical0-19 guarded replays included exactly once, not pooled again with preserved unguarded baseline
denominators: For each condition/method preserve target1000,actual requested,completed,guard-valid,guard-invalid,process-failed,in-flight/uncheckpointed and not-yet-requested. Complete parameter rows are mandatory even for recorded invalid fits. Invalid outcomes never enter valid-only numeric estimates; their denominator and reasons remain visible. No replacement seeds or favorable retry selection.
unique_key: mechanism,q,missing,replicate,method,parameter; fixed seed rule is checked. Duplicate ledger datasets or duplicate parameter rows cause an error, not implicit weighting or silent replacement.

truths.beta_rule: Each beta=sqrt(.64/(q*(2+.6*(q-1)))); h2 is residual A/(A+C+E), not A/1.64

parameter_summary: For every A,C,E,h2,beta parameter retain estimate mean,between-dataset SD,MCSE,bias,RMSE,model-SE mean/SD/MCSE; path-SE summaries only for A,C,E with explicit different-estimand label. All numeric summaries condition on guard-valid fits.

families.name: Primary paired variance-SE contrast deletion minus full
families.positive: Full information has lower estimated variance-component SE
families.interval: Paired Student t Bonferroni mean intervals; also two-MCSE intervals

families.name: Exploratory paired path-SE contrasts
families.interval: Same rules but separate metric; not variance-SE reproduction

families.name: Source variance-SE reproduction deviations
families.interval: Bonferroni Student t for our mean plus source extraction bound; source Monte Carlo error unknown

families.name: Exploratory source path-SE reconstruction
families.interval: Separate same-shaped conditional band; not same estimand as printed variance labels

families.name: MAR estimate reproduction deviations
families.interval: Bonferroni Student t plus extraction bound; exploratory as established in prior checkpoint

families.name: MAR signed estimate-minus-truth biases
families.interval: Bonferroni Student t for our signed bias; source extraction sign uncertainty separate, source Monte Carlo unknown

source_mapping: Figure low-missingness label maps to.02 in primary source comparisons; .03 sensitivity stays separate. Source display rounding is not measurement precision; numerical rounding verdict withheld for figure-derived targets.
signs: Scientific paired contrast is SE(deletion)-SE(full),positive means full information more precise. Scientific bias is estimate-generating truth,positive means overestimation. Ours-minus-source is a separate reproduction deviation. Report all point-sign reversals with extraction-bound robustness and our interval status; do not promote a source point sign to an established source ranking.
uncertainty_limits: Intervals describe independent generated datasets conditional on declared model and guard-valid subset. Missing or invalid fits can induce selection; no general all-requested inference is claimed. Normal-mean/Student approximations may be poor at small n; n<2 yields no interval. Source Monte Carlo uncertainty is unknown; extraction bounds are not confidence intervals. These are not equivalence tests or directly estimated power.
interim: All interim analyses are descriptive fixed-n checkpoints, not sequential confidence procedures or stopping rules. A complete attempted grid may still have invalid fits and does not establish successful source replication or whole-dissertation completion.
preservation: Write only a distinct output directory; do not overwrite outputs/ baseline or running report inputs. Record source/input/code/plan hashes with every analysis. Final analysis requires independently reviewed frozen code and validated exported checkpoint data.
prior_information: Preserved20-replicate baseline and operational progress/guard counts were known; no new production effect summaries inspected when specifying this plan.
